g.text: Whadio — recording a meeting: capture → transcript → notes → delivery
sample active speaker from Meet DOM
A chunk is retried until acknowledged;
the seq number makes the upload idempotent.
Find captures idle past the timeout
Assemble the received chunks into the recording
state = queued, mark recording as partial
Name speakers from the stored speaker events;
Load preset, provider config and the context set
Build the prompt from the preset,
Save notes and the context used; set the proposed
name, marked as generated; state = processed;
Claim the reserved notice after the commit
Show transcript and notes; prompt to name
the meeting, prefilled with the generated name
The prompt is designed; not built yet:
today the generated name stays until the
member renames the meeting through the API.
Save the name, no longer marked as generated
